# ⚑⚑ EXCEPT IT WAS NOT, AND THAT IS THE POINT. The command above is what the sibling
# distributions ran and what this file must be regenerated with once it resolves. Today it
# does not: this distribution's dev group carries `paperkit`, which is not in any package
# registry, so `uv pip compile --group dev` exits "requirements are unsatisfiable" and
# produces NO lock at all. The pinned content below was compiled from `pytest` alone.
#
# ⚑ THE DIVERGENCE IS RECORDED RATHER THAN HIDDEN because the two are not equivalent: a
# bazel `py_test` staged from this lock gets a test runner and NOT the projection engine,
# so a witness that imports paperkit would fail at import inside a hermetic action while
# passing on a host that happens to have it. That is the same
# resolves-out-of-the-sandbox class MODULE.bazel already refuses for editable installs.
# ⟡mtools-paperkit-devlock retires this when paperkit publishes.
